name: Cosmic Avatar (Psychic Discipline)
body:
Whether the legends about the Cosmic Phoenix are true or not, you seem to be in contact with this mysterious force—and at times, it even threatens to overwhelm you.

Phrenic Pool Ability: Charisma.

Bonus Spells: life pact (2nd), ablative barrier (4th), fly (6th), flaming aura (8th), telekinesis (10th), incendiary cloud (12th), telekinetic sphere (14th), polymorph any object (16th), akashic form (18th)

Discipline Powers: When you use your powers, you are possessed by the spirit of the cosmic phoenix, and become an unstoppable force for creation—or destruction.

Piety of Cosmos (Su)

You add all cure spells (all spells with “cure” in their name) to your psychic spell list and to your list of spells known, just like a good-aligned oracle.

Creatures cured by you appear to be engulfed in flames, but these flames deal no damage.

Flaming Psyche (Ex)

You gain Elemental Spell (fire) as a bonus feat.
